description: Aggregate recent AI coding assistant sessions into counts: sessions per assistant, total messages, distinct projects, token totals and estimated cost. No session message text is returned. hours bounds the window, project, cli and user narrow what is aggregated. compliance_withheld counts the Compliance API export sessions that were found and withheld unread because reading them needs an Enterprise license; they contribute nothing to the counts.

cli.description: Only sessions recorded by this assistant, for example claude, codex or cursor.

hours.description: Only sessions active in the last N hours. 0 aggregates all history. Default 168.

project.description: Only sessions whose project name or path matches this filter.

user.description: Only sessions whose user id or email address matches this filter; only a Compliance API export carries either.

name: session_stats
title: Session statistics
